title: Everyday Phrases — Hotel Check-In
scene_zh: 飯店入住 · 情境對話
title_quote: Hi, I would like to check in.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🏨 實用飯店入住必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A1 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Hotel Check-In
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用飯店入住情境對話（報到訂房、房卡押金、早餐與QR Code無線網路、周邊諮詢），每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Hotel Check-In phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering reservations, keycards, breakfast, Wi-Fi, deposits and asking about the neighborhood. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I would like to check in.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ, aɪ wʊd laɪk tə tʃɛk ɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you have a reservation?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, I booked it online last week.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, aɪ bʊkt ɪt ˈɔnˌlaɪn læst wik./
dialogue.zh: 有的，我上週在網路上訂的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What name is on the booking?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is Daniel, Daniel Lee.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How do you spell that, please?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lee, one L and two E's.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, Mr. Lee.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I also have a confirmation email.
dialogue.zh: 我還收到一封確認郵件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Could you read me the number?
dialogue.zh: 能把訂單號碼唸給我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It starts with B, then 7-2-9.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stɑrts wɪθ bi, ðɛn ˈsɛvən tu naɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, I see your booking.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我看到您的訂單了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, thanks for the help!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You booked three nights, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, three nights with breakfast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And checkout is on Thursday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly, I fly home that day.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，那天我搭飛機回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Would you like a late checkout?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe, I will decide tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem at all, sir.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need to see my ID?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju nid tə si maɪ aɪˈdi?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A passport or license is fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is my passport from Taiwan.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, I will scan it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you give it back soon?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, just one quick scan.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Of course, that is normal.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is your birth date correct here?
dialogue.zh: 這裡的出生日期正確嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me look... yes, it is.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your phone number for records?
dialogue.zh: 留一組電話號碼好記錄？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, let me read it out.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, your email too?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, it is on the booking page.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt ɪz ɑn ðə ˈbʊkɪŋ peɪdʒ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, who will be staying with you?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ, hu wɪl bi ˈsteɪɪŋ wɪð ju?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is just me and my son.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz dʒʌst mi ænd maɪ sʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One child, no extra fee.
dialogue.zh: 一位小朋友，不加收費用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is so kind of you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does he need his own bed?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two beds in the room, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your room has two twin beds.
dialogue.zh: 您的房間有兩張單人床。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, he hates sharing beds.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，他不愛擠一張床。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smoking or non-smoking, sir?
dialogue.zh: 您要吸菸房還是無菸房？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Non-smoking for us, for sure.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All rooms here are smoke-free.
dialogue.zh: 我們所有房間都禁止吸菸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even better for my boy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any floor you would like?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A quiet room on a high floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈkwaɪət rum ɑn ə haɪ flɔr./
dialogue.zh: 要樓層高又安靜的房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The eighth floor is very calm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds lovely to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me add that to your notes.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi æd ðæt tə jʊr noʊts./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I come too early today?
dialogue.zh: 我今天是不是來太早了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check-in starts at three p.m.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ɪn stɑrts æt θri ˌpi ˈɛm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, it is only noon.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But your room may be ready.
dialogue.zh: 不過您的房間可能準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? That would help so much.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me ask housekeeping now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take your time, no rush.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good news, the room is clear.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wonderful, we are so tired.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Long flight from Taipei?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve hours, almost no sleep.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then rest well tonight, both of you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn rɛst wɛl təˈnaɪt, boʊθ ʌv ju./
dialogue.zh: 那今晚你們兩位都要好好休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My son is already yawning.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us finish these short forms.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which paper do I sign first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The top one, please, right here.
dialogue.zh: 請簽上面那張，就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And just my name here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and today's date too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. What about the second one?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those are the rules, just read them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðoz ɑr ðə rulz, dʒʌst rid ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 那頁是住房須知，看看就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will read them in the room.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl rid ðɛm ɪn ðə rum./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is your passport back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, you were very quick.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One small thing about payment.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I paid when I booked.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We still need a card on file.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi stɪl nid ə kɑrd ɑn faɪl./
dialogue.zh: 還是要留一張卡做紀錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is that for, exactly?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Minibar or room service charges.
dialogue.zh: 迷你吧或房內點餐的消費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ah, that makes sense.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you have a credit card?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, here is my Visa card.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please type your PIN, sir.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, I entered the numbers.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Approved, thank you very much.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So am I all checked in?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, one small step left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are so helpful, thanks.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We like to keep it simple.
dialogue.zh: 我們也想讓流程簡單些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my son in the file, too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz maɪ sʌn ɪn ðə faɪl, tu?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, both names are listed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, hotels are strict about that.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Safety first, we hope you agree.
dialogue.zh: 安全第一，我想您會認同。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Absolutely, better safe than tired.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now let me print your details.
dialogue.zh: 現在我把資料列印出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please, read them out to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First, here is your room number.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight twelve, on the eighth floor.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and here is the keycard.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just one card for us?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will make a second one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How does this keycard work?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap it near the door handle.
dialogue.zh: 在門把手旁邊輕刷一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it open the door right away?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ɪt ˈoʊpən ðə dɔr raɪt əˈweɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, once the light turns green.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if it does not work?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring it here, we fix it fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ɪt hɪr, wi fɪks ɪt fæst./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that second card ready now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here you go, it works the same.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ju ɡoʊ, ɪt wɜrks ðə seɪm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the card need charging?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it lasts all three days.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I keep it somewhere safe?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please, we charge for lost cards.
dialogue.zh: 請務必保管，遺失要賠償。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Understood, I will guard it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, your room faces the park.
dialogue.zh: 您的房間正面對著公園。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The park view, how nice!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The trees keep the noise away.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it noisy near the street?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not on that side, don't worry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you tell me the room size?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju tɛl mi ðə rum saɪz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About thirty square meters.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Enough space for our bags.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a rack for suitcases.
dialogue.zh: 還有專門放行李箱的架子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a desk to work at?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə dɛsk tə wɜrk æt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, by the wide window.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the lamp have good light?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is a bright new lamp.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is on the walls?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Local photos of the coast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice touch, I like that.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, about breakfast tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 接下來說說明天的早餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time does it start?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven a.m. until ten.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we go to eat?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The breakfast room, right downstairs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need to book a table?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi nid tə bʊk ə ˈteɪbəl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, just walk right in.
dialogue.zh: 不用，直接走進去找位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show my card at the door?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, to prove you are guests.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What food do you serve there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eggs, fruit, bread, cereal.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they cook eggs in front of you?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðeɪ kʊk ɛɡz ɪn frʌnt ʌv ju?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, there is an omelet station.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My son loves cheese omelets.
dialogue.zh: 我兒子最愛起司歐姆蛋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He will be a happy boy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the coffee any good there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fresh coffee, free refills.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free refills, my favorite word.
dialogue.zh: 免費續杯，我最愛這四個字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is also juice and milk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any Asian food for breakfast?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rice and soup are served too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Amazing, we came to the right place.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈmeɪzɪŋ, wi keɪm tə ðə raɪt pleɪs./
dialogue.zh: 太棒了，我們來對地方了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now the Wi-Fi details.
dialogue.zh: 再來是無線網路的部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the code on that card?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, scan the QR code.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Or should I type it by hand?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔr ʃʊd aɪ taɪp ɪt baɪ hænd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Either way works fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does Wi-Fi reach up to eight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Strong signal on every floor.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I connect my phone and laptop?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ kəˈnɛkt maɪ foʊn ænd ˈlæpˌtɑp?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, up to five devices.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it safe for online banking?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The guest network is protected.
dialogue.zh: 房客用的網路是有保護的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I will video-call my wife.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, aɪ wɪl ˈvɪdioʊ kɔl maɪ waɪf./
dialogue.zh: 好，我可以跟太太視訊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She will see the park view.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you also take a deposit?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is fifty dollars per night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you take cash deposits?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Card is easier, if possible.
dialogue.zh: 可能的話刷卡比較方便。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will use this same Visa.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, nothing charged yet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When do you take the money?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if there are charges.
dialogue.zh: 只有在產生消費時才會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And I get it back at checkout?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd aɪ ɡɛt ɪt bæk æt ˈtʃɛkaʊt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it comes right back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the minibar inside the room?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is the small fridge.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are those snacks expensive?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Prices are listed on the card.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, we will just browse.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fridge has free water too.
dialogue.zh: 冰箱裡還有免費瓶裝水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free water, smart thinking.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We know travel makes you thirsty.
dialogue.zh: 我們知道旅行容易口渴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the room safe?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It sits inside the closet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I choose my own code?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, any four numbers work.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can staff open it if I forget?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn stæf ˈoʊpən ɪt ɪf aɪ fərˈɡɛt?/
dialogue.zh: 我忘記密碼員工能開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, if you show your ID.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will write the code down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl raɪt ðə koʊd daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 好，那我會把密碼寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A wise plan, Mr. Lee.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How does the air conditioner work?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a panel by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə ˈpænl baɪ ðə dɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I make it cooler at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ meɪk ɪt ˈkulər æt naɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, sleep as cool as you like.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs, slip æz kul æz ju laɪk./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the curtains, do they close fully?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈkɜrtənz, du ðeɪ kloʊz ˈfʊli?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They keep the morning sun out.
dialogue.zh: 一早的陽光都照不進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will sleep until ten.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just skip that breakfast, then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No way, we go for omelets.
dialogue.zh: 不行，我們一定要吃歐姆蛋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will see you at eight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before we go up, what else is here?
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔr wi ɡoʊ ʌp, wʌt ɛls ɪz hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 上樓之前，這裡還有什麼設施？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have a gym and a pool.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv ə dʒɪm ænd ə pul./
dialogue.zh: 我們有健身房和游泳池。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where exactly is the gym?
dialogue.zh: 健身房確切位置在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Second floor, past the stairs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time does the gym open?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six a.m. until ten p.m.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˌeɪ ˈɛm ʌnˈtɪl tɛn ˌpi ˈɛm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do guests pay for the gym?
dialogue.zh: 房客用健身房要付費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No charge, it comes with your stay.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ tʃɑrdʒ, ɪt kʌmz wɪð jʊr steɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are there weights and machines?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, plus two spinning bikes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My son would run with me.
dialogue.zh: 我兒子會跟我一起慢跑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kids must stay with an adult.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Understood, no problem there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, the rooftop pool.
dialogue.zh: 接下來是樓頂的游泳池。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pool is up top?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tenth floor, open air.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you see the city from it?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju si ðə ˈsɪti frʌm ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All the city lights, so pretty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the water warm in fall?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the pool is heated.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we bring our own towels?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clean ones wait by the pool.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When can we swim, then?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight in the morning till nine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there food up there too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small café sits beside it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, we will try both places.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，兩個地方我們都想去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just bring your room card up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How about washing our clothes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We offer a laundry service.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you return them the same day?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju rɪˈtɜrn ðɛm ðə seɪm deɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, if sent before ten a.m.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪf sɛnt bɪˈfɔr tɛn ˌeɪ ˈɛm./
dialogue.zh: 可以，早上十點前送洗就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I leave the bag?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the laundry list in-room.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And how much per piece?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Prices are listed on that form.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there an ice machine?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every floor, beside the stairs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And vending machines for snacks?
dialogue.zh: 那賣零食的自動販賣機呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two of them on the first floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ʌv ðɛm ɑn ðə fɜrst flɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the hotel have a spa?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can book massages here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe tomorrow, after sightseeing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It takes all the tired away.
dialogue.zh: 一天的疲勞馬上就消了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is housekeeping done every day?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, unless you hang the sign.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which sign says do not disturb?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The red one on the knob.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the other one means clean?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, hang it by noon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who can help with our luggage?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Marco, our bellhop, carries it up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Marco, that is his name?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten years he has worked here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He must really love this job.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here he comes, smiling already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi Marco, these bags are ours.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two suitcases and one backpack?
dialogue.zh: 兩個行李箱加一個背包？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the blue one is his.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will send them up first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we ride the elevator too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, guests go up this way.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I tap my card inside?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, then press the number eight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So it goes straight to our floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ɪt ɡoʊz streɪt tə ˈaʊər flɔr./
dialogue.zh: 所以直接就到我們那層。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very safe, like you noticed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How does he get back down, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ dʌz hi ɡɛt bæk daʊn, ðɛn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The staff elevator is different.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ding, we are on floor eight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your door is third on the right.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr dɔr ɪz θɜrd ɑn ðə raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 右邊第三間就是您的門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This hallway smells really fresh.
dialogue.zh: 這條走廊聞起來好清新。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We clean it every morning.
dialogue.zh: 我們每天早上都會清潔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The carpet feels so soft.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bare feet stay cozy here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here we are, eight twelve.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me swipe and open it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The green light came on!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome to your room, sir.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, it looks bigger inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The park view opens it up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those green trees are so calming.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The beds are made, towels folded.
dialogue.zh: 床鋪好了，毛巾也摺好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two twins, just as we asked.
dialogue.zh: 兩張單人床，跟我們要的一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Marco left your bags on the rack.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɑrkoʊ lɛft jʊr bæɡz ɑn ðə ræk./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I test these lamps now?
dialogue.zh: 我現在可以試試台燈嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, the switches are by your beds.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs, ðə ˈswɪtʃəz ɑr baɪ jʊr bɛdz./
dialogue.zh: 當然，開關就在床的兩側。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one gives a warm glow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cozy for reading at night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bathroom looks very clean too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Extra towels are in the cabinet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two fluffy blue ones!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soap and glasses are inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hot water comes fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have a new water heater.
dialogue.zh: 我們剛換了新的熱水器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last check, the blackout curtains.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull the cord, they glide shut.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Total darkness, impressive!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anything else this evening, sir?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not now, but maybe later.
dialogue.zh: 現在沒有，待會兒說不定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dial zero, we answer day and night.
dialogue.phonetic: /daɪəl ˈzɪroʊ, wi ˈænsər deɪ ænd naɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hello, this is eight twelve.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good evening, how can I help?
dialogue.zh: 晚上好，請問有什麼可以幫忙？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry to call so late tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No need to apologize, sir.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pillow feels a little flat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Would you like a fluffier one?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, two soft ones, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will send Marco right up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are the best, thanks.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is truly our pleasure.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we get a blanket too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A spare one is on the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə spɛr wʌn ɪz ɑn ðə weɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it the warm kind?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is soft and warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we get one more for my boy?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi ɡɛt wʌn mɔr fər maɪ bɔɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two blankets, two pillows coming.
dialogue.zh: 兩條毯子兩顆枕頭，馬上到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Marco is already at the door!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is fast, our star worker.
dialogue.zh: 他動作飛快，我們的明星員工。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These pillows feel like clouds.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is really nice to hear that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈrɪəli naɪs tə hɪr ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 聽您這樣說我就放心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing for the bathroom.
dialogue.zh: 還想麻煩一件浴室用品。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Toothbrush, comb, or razor?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two toothbrushes with toothpaste.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Marco will bring them upstairs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please tell him we are sorry.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He will only smile at you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sell phone chargers here?
dialogue.zh: 飯店有賣手機充電線嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We lend free ones at the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi lɛnd fri wʌnz æt ðə dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 櫃台有免費的可以借用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we borrow one?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take it, return by checkout.
dialogue.zh: 拿去用，退房前歸還就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have five percent left.
dialogue.zh: 我手機只剩百分之五了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will send one up with Marco.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl sɛnd wʌn ʌp wɪð ˈmɑrkoʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And warm milk for my little boy?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd wɔrm mɪlk fər maɪ ˈlɪtəl bɔɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 還有一杯溫牛奶給我兒子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Room service can bring that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long will it take them?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten minutes, maybe a bit less.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hallway light stays very bright.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It dims after midnight, don't worry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, my boy sleeps early.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep well, both of you tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning, it is eight twelve here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good morning, is all well?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The air conditioner was noisy last night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ɛr kənˈdɪʃənər wʌz ˈnɔɪzi læst naɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So sorry, we will fix it now.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈsɑri, wi wɪl fɪks ɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 非常抱歉，我們立刻處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It sounds quiet already?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our worker fixed the panel.
dialogue.zh: 技工已經把面板修好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You fixed it before breakfast!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We hate waking our guests.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hot water ran cold once.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give the tap one minute more.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, steaming hot now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old pipes clear themselves fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we get coffee in our room?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd wi ɡɛt ˈkɔfi ɪn ˈaʊər rum?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One coffee coming right up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Actually, we will eat downstairs.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will save a window table.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A window table? You are sweet!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can watch the park from it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn wɑtʃ ðə pɑrk frʌm ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: About that late checkout.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What time do you need to leave?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt taɪm du ju nid tə liv?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we stay until two p.m.?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd wi steɪ ʌnˈtɪl tu ˌpi ˈɛm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two p.m. has a small fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˌpi ˈɛm hæz ə smɔl fi./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the extra fee?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty dollars for the delay.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is eleven a.m. free then?
dialogue.zh: 那十一點退房是免費的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, eleven costs nothing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eleven works for us, thanks.
dialogue.zh: 十一點對我們剛好，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, I updated your keycard.
dialogue.zh: 好了，房卡時間也更新了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our flight is in the evening.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then enjoy a full last day.
dialogue.zh: 那就好好享受最後一整天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we store bags after checkout?
dialogue.zh: 退房後可以寄存行李嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, our storage room is free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When do we get them back?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By nine in the evening, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, where should we go today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What things do you enjoy?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Museums, parks, good street food.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The old town has all three.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do we get to the old town?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du wi ɡɛt tə ði oʊld taʊn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The subway goes straight there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the nearest station?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two blocks left, past the bank.
dialogue.zh: 往左兩個街口，過了銀行就是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we buy tickets at the station?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi baɪ ˈtɪkɪts æt ði ˈsteɪʃən?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, machines take cards too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a cheap day pass?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten dollars for the whole day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do kids ride for free?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under six rides without paying.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He is five, perfect!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He will love riding trains.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is a popular place to see?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ə ˈpɑpjələr pleɪs tə si?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The harbor market, absolutely.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it far from the old town?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt fɑr frʌm ði oʊld taʊn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One subway stop, then a short walk.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈsʌbˌweɪ stɑp, ðɛn ə ʃɔrt wɔk./
dialogue.zh: 地鐵一站，再走一下就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it sunny outside today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cloudy later, light rain possible.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we bring an umbrella?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Borrow one from us today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You have it all.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breakfast until ten, Mr. Lee.
